definitions.explanation: Black tea served cold over ice. In Japan it is usually unsweetened when ordered in a café, with syrup (ガムシロップ) and milk or lemon offered on the side.

examples.japanese: アイスティー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アイスティー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飲|の}みたく→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: On hot days I feel like drinking iced tea.

examples.japanese: アイスティー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦ミルク→ミルク：00284_miruku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けます→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would you like lemon or milk with your iced tea?
